Open-Bridge: Open-Source Software for Hybrid Photonic-Wetware Computing
partialText: <p>Hi everyone! I am an 11-year-old independent researcher, and I have published Open-Bridge (Project Synapse-Optima) on GitHub under the MIT License.It is a free integration layer designed to sync 3D brain organoids on MEA substrates with photonic computing hardware. The core implements the Donoho/MAD method for adaptive spike-sorting and MIT's Liquid Neural Networks for cross-frequency temporal synchronization.You can review the simulation core and run the script here: <a href="https://github.com/nlozkina19-crypto/open-bridge-synapse-optima" rel="noopener noreferrer">https://github.com/nlozkina19-crypto/open-bridge-synapse-optima</a> would love to get your feedback and technical critique!</p>
